name: Soy Milk
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as it's naturally lactose-free and low FODMAP. Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added high-FODMAP sweeteners.
preparationTips: Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added FODMAPs like inulin or high fructose corn syrup
Check ingredient labels for carrageenan, which may cause digestive upset in sensitive individuals
Shake well before use as separation is natural
Can be heated for coffee drinks or used in cooking without FODMAP concerns
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Fortified with calcium and vitamin D
Contains isoflavones with potential health benefits
Lower in saturated fat than whole dairy milk
